category.name: Comments
category.preferred_workflow: Employ Document, DocumentBuilder, and Comment directly; enumerate comments with doc.GetChildNodes(NodeType.Comment, true).OfType<Comment>(); create a safe List copy before bulk deletions; always include at least one Paragraph and Run inside a new comment; reset MemoryStream.Position before reloading or resaving; and rely only on documented save-option properties.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference a non-existent Document.Comments collection; use GetChildNodes instead.
Do not invent a Aspose.Words.Comments namespace or builder shortcuts such as StartComment or EndComment.
Do not use CommentReference, HtmlSaveOptions.ExportComments, or PdfSaveOptions.ExportComments as they are not part of the API.
canonical_patterns: When creating a comment, append at least one Paragraph and one Run to provide visible content.
Copy a live comment collection to a List before performing bulk updates or deletions.
Extract plain comment data first and rebuild destination documents from that data for export scenarios.
Reset MemoryStream.Position to zero before reloading a document from a stream.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check for null before dereferencing objects such as Paragraph? or Comment? to avoid CS8602.
Assign maybe-null values only to nullable locals; declare variables as nullable when appropriate.
Guard FirstOrDefault results and other potentially null expressions before use.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061: 'Node' does not contain a definition for 'Text'.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to read .Text on the abstract Node type instead of a concrete Run or using Comment.GetText().
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace Node.Text with Comment.GetText() for whole-comment content or cast to Run before accessing .Text.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always access text through Run.Text or Comment.GetText() and avoid using Node.Text on non-text nodes.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0234: The type or namespace name 'Comments' does not exist in the namespace 'Aspose.Words'.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references a non-existent Document.Comments property or Aspose.Words.Comments namespace.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Never use undocumented comment collection shortcuts; rely on the official GetChildNodes method.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 or CS0117 errors for CommentReference, HtmlSaveOptions.ExportComments, PdfSaveOptions.ExportComments.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code calls members that are not defined in the current Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove the unsupported calls and use only documented properties; comments are exported by default in PDF and HTML saves.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official API reference for supported members before adding comment-related options.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime NotSupportedException when adding or removing nodes while iterating a live NodeCollection.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code modifies the comment collection during forward iteration, causing the underlying collection to change.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create a ToList copy of the comment collection before performing deletions or additions.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always work on a detached List copy when mutating comment nodes in bulk.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS8600, CS8602, CS8604 warnings around maybe-null values such as CurrentParagraph or FirstOrDefault results.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assigns or dereferences values that may be null without null checks or nullable annotations.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Introduce nullable locals (e.g., Paragraph?) and guard them with if (variable != null) before use.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Enable nullable reference analysis and add explicit null checks for all potentially null API returns.

narrative.overview: The Comments category for Aspose.Words focuses on programmatic handling of comment nodes, including enumeration, creation, updating, deletion, and export. Verified examples illustrate adding nested replies, filtering comments by date, and exporting comment data to CSV, JSON, and PDF while preserving formatting.
narrative.purpose: Guide an AI coding assistant to implement robust comment manipulation using the native Aspose.Words API, avoiding unsupported shortcuts and ensuring compile-time correctness and runtime stability.
validation_priorities: Ensure compile-time correctness and null-safety before testing runtime behavior.
maintenance_notes: Review and update this documentation whenever a new Aspose.Words version adds, changes, or deprecates comment-related members.
